summary: A fun, debate-starting daily: Mario, Pokemon, Call of Duty, GTA and Minecraft are gimmes, Tetris at #2 surprises, and Zelda, Halo and The Sims missing the top 10 are great near misses. Suits the classic list better than Blitz.
reasons: Casual run: Mario, Pokemon, Call of Duty, GTA, Minecraft, FIFA, Tetris, Assassin's Creed, Final Fantasy found; lives went on Zelda #15, Halo #35, The Sims #13, Street Fighter #47. 9/10 with 1 life left, missing Resident Evil.
Fortnite (free-to-play) is not an answer and costs nothing, which is right. Top-10 values and order match the source.

Blitz 22 of 30: Pac-Man, Skyrim, Red Dead Redemption, Mario Kart-style sub-series names and free games (Candy Crush, Angry Birds) score nothing; 'uncharted' costs a life in classic by matching Koei's Uncharted Waters.
fixes: Drop 'Educational games in the Sonic the Hedgehog series' from the unranked pool: it makes 'sonic' ambiguous with Sonic the Hedgehog (#18).
'uncharted' resolves to Uncharted Waters (unranked, costs a life). Add Naughty Dog's Uncharted to the pool, or drop the bare 'Uncharted' short form from Uncharted Waters.
Pac-Man is not in the pool at all ('pacman' offers Batman: Arkham / Rayman). Add it as an accepted answer.

Missing aliases for sub-series and flagship games: 'Mario Kart', 'Mario Party', 'Luigi' -> Mario; 'Wii Sports', 'Wii Fit' -> Wii; 'Red Dead Redemption' -> Red Dead; 'Skyrim' -> The Elder Scrolls; 'GTA V' / 'GTA 5' -> Grand Theft Auto.
